provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.syntax.heap.routing against rust:mdbook-dada/src/routing.rs:route, rust:mdbook-dada/src/routing.rs:clear, rust:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:render, test:mdbook-dada/src/routing.rs:tests::routes_around_boxes_and_through_column_gaps, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:cycle_tests::cycles_self_loops_and_disconnected_cycles_render_deterministically, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:lease_tests::leases_join_edges_and_shleases_target_objects. route constructs horizontal/vertical corridor nodes around rectangles and searches by distance plus a bend penalty; clear excludes interior crossings and route reports an error on failure. The routing and graph tests check orthogonal segments against boxes, reverse directions, column gaps, cycles and lease junctions. They do not promise nonoverlap between distinct edges or labels. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:meta.syntax.heap.rendering.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
